handoff: Approve: review #1's blocking YAML-alias finding is fixed (structuredClone copy + aliasDuplicateObjects:false, tested); all four like: criteria traced to tests; suite and typecheck green; __proto__ minor stays a note.

findings.title: A step named __proto__ is dropped during like resolution instead of refused (carried from review #1, not fixed)
findings.detail:
resolveLikes builds out as a plain object, so out['__proto__'] = step sets its prototype instead of adding a key; a workflow with a like step and a __proto__ step flattens without it rather than being refused by the step-name pattern.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Build out with Object.create(null) or Object.defineProperty so the step reaches the schema check.
